title: Failure Is Not An Option

searchText: Perigate is looking for someone to ruin their reputation to get them out of going to Space by failing their induction. You run around town failing all the JASA tests but Pocket isn't falling for it. The only way is for Perigate to join the resistance and annoy Jonaco! Copper wants them to prove themselves by destroying the Statue of Masculinity - only possible by orbital strike! You fire the strike and trigger a code head and have to report to Lovehart who declares it's actually great for Jonas and Perigate is promoted to Space Supervisor! You let her know she's going to space but the promotion seems to balance things out!

title: Brometheus
summary: Spectre is owed money from a high society member and wants your help getting their money. You learn you can fake credentials for high society with Klacky and then go to Datcgery to get an invite to a posh…
searchText: Spectre is owed money from a high society member and wants your help getting their money. You learn you can fake credentials for high society with Klacky and then go to Datcgery to get an invite to a posh party. You seek out Alfonse - the one who owes spectre money - and find his chest exploded! You track something in the vents. Turns out to be an alien called Xeno who's trying to communicate that it left an egg behind and needs Spectres help. (the bursting out of the chest thing is just part of the reproductive cycle!). You grab the egg from Jonapost and take it to spectre to take into space and save Xeno's species.

title: Look Who's Talking
summary: Hogwood is looking for Stage Hands to help find her stolen doll Hopscotch and she suspects Grigonna (her mother!) You find the Pyramid of Disappointment and learn G wants to talk to Hpgwood! You learn G…
searchText: Hogwood is looking for Stage Hands to help find her stolen doll Hopscotch and she suspects Grigonna (her mother!) You find the Pyramid of Disappointment and learn G wants to talk to Hpgwood! You learn G has left some Art for Hogwood which leads you to the Paracryptic Mirrors where you find out she wants Hogwood to quit and take up dentistry. You also learn that Hopscotch left to perform a one doll show! You go to see it and see a grizzly site - they want to play a game! You start with Sparks who gives you a Monstermon Card to fight Hopscotch's! Finally, you go to Winter and play a game of dice but have to trade your new Monstermon with Winter for their help! Finally Hopscotch wants Hogwood to perform on a Game Show together before they return! You take part but Hpgwood shuts it down before Hopscotch gets too homicidal!

title: Tricky Treats
summary: Datchery has had teenagers stealing all her Billy Bonka chocolate looking for a Purple Ticket to meet Bonka themself! You win one and learn the teens are crones and have captured the Candyman - aka Bonka!…
searchText: Datchery has had teenagers stealing all her Billy Bonka chocolate looking for a Purple Ticket to meet Bonka themself! You win one and learn the teens are crones and have captured the Candyman - aka Bonka! They want to summon the REAL Candyman so you ask Halloway who has previous experience! You learn the Legend of the Candyman, and that their summoners are in Manes Lake. You call to beg them to stop and eventually find their remains at My Absmore and a note that leads to a call with the Candyman - they want a dental appointment! You go to Robodoc for help - as a result the Candyman has left Datchery a gift! They turned the crones into sweets to keep Datchery safe

title: Absnormal Abduction
summary: Rexford is convinced they've been abducted by aliens! You find an artifact and learn someone thinks Hogwood might be an alien - they're were just acting - but you discover the artifact is Jonaco property…
searchText: Rexford is convinced they've been abducted by aliens! You find an artifact and learn someone thinks Hogwood might be an alien - they're were just acting - but you discover the artifact is Jonaco property - they're pretending to be aliens!. You sign a NDA with Lovehart and learn Jonaco is stealing Rexford and Platman's blood with Project Legion trying to make more Platmen! You stitch up another townsfolk to dress as Platman, therefore stopping Rexford from death by blood loss.

title: The Silence of the Toys

searchText: Littlefield has had some of their toys stolen! They suspect Egbert Simpbury so you investigate and find a videomatic of King Bendy holding them hostage. You find the toys in the abandoned squat and learn King Bendy is leading toys to slaughter their 'gods'. Bendy is looking for the JONACO Knife to kill Littlefield - you need to convince Littlefield to kill Bendy before they kill first. You find King Bendy trying to get the knife and take them to Littlefield for them to end the saga

title: The Shape of Goo
summary: Winter is convinced there's an alien shape shifter in town! You track them on CCTV to the Jonagraph and ask Perigate about it. She says it was ringing it bell in a weird pattern (morse code) which…
searchText: Winter is convinced there's an alien shape shifter in town! You track them on CCTV to the Jonagraph and ask Perigate about it. She says it was ringing it bell in a weird pattern (morse code) which translates to HELP GRAVE BARK. You find it's refers to Graham Bark and you find a videomatic of them experimenting with transforming themself into a half man half platypus. It goes wrong and turns him into the shape shifter we are hunting. You find a note to his Mama and you learn they got the idea from an episode of The New Adventures of Jonas. You watch and learn Spectre and Vox specialise in shape shifting goo and make contact with Graham via the mirrors. Turms out Dr Winter can help do you ask for their help but they decide to destroy the goo Graham instead!

title: Final Countdown
summary: Pocket has started a self destruct for the town - but they think it was actually Terence! You check on it but they've been captured for trying to blow up the moon. You learn you can win the chance to talk…
searchText: Pocket has started a self destruct for the town - but they think it was actually Terence! You check on it but they've been captured for trying to blow up the moon. You learn you can win the chance to talk to them by joining Hustlepus University. When you chat to them, they mention Pocket is cursed and you watch the story of their meeting with the Wizard of the Mines where they are warned not to activate the self destruct! You talk to Sparks and join the Wizarding Club to learn more and find out the Wizard looks a lot like Furbish. You check their grave and watch the videomatic listed to find out Pocket found Furbish on the mines! You learn of the prophecy and find a crown to help Pocket pull a sword from a box and break the curse (which doesn't exist, Furbish just saw it coming and gave the command to cancel the countdown!)

title: Viva La Resistance
summary: Copper is looking for a new leader for the resistance - first job, fire Sparks! (Jonaco wants Sparks in charge cos they're useless!) Next you learn the values of the resistance - Bravery, Freedom and…
searchText: Copper is looking for a new leader for the resistance - first job, fire Sparks! (Jonaco wants Sparks in charge cos they're useless!) Next you learn the values of the resistance - Bravery, Freedom and Coolness! Platman has all these qualities but you find a grave for them! Has Platman died? You offer your condolences to Rexford and suggest they might be a good leader but they suggest Terence the Talking Platypus - who will consider it of you help them break out of the JONACO 5 star prison! You use Klacky to hack the security and get them out. They suggest you speak to Lovehart to rebrand the resistance - which also makes you realise Copper is the only logical choice to lead it! You go back to talk her into taking on the lead job!

title: The Good, The Bad and The Milky
summary: Halloway is looking for Bread the Bounty Hunter - so you pose as them to get the gig. They've had their dynamite stolen! You start with the trail from the undertaker and find reference to Sherrif Rexford…
searchText: Halloway is looking for Bread the Bounty Hunter - so you pose as them to get the gig. They've had their dynamite stolen! You start with the trail from the undertaker and find reference to Sherrif Rexford so you talk to Rexford - the Sherrif was their Uncle (AKA the Milkman) so you find them and call via Jonagraph. You're interrupted by the Banshee Bandit. You watch a film on the Bandit and learn about the Hold Em Steal - which Halloways Mother was involved in! She shot the bandit - according to the bandit anyway! You need to beat them at poker to stop them so you ask Copper for help as the resident poker expert who gives you a rigged deck to help you beat the bandit!

title: The Great Undoing
summary: People are collecting up gifts from the heavens so you talk to Pius about collecting meteors - his speaks to him and gives a videomatic code. You watch and learn "the axiomatic rift is ready" and the…
searchText: People are collecting up gifts from the heavens so you talk to Pius about collecting meteors - his speaks to him and gives a videomatic code. You watch and learn "the axiomatic rift is ready" and the jonaco mark 3 rocket is ready to go with captain Perigate to begin "the great undoing" - but it appears this videomatic is 2 years into the future - since the Mark 1 hasn't launched yet! You ask Perigate and they mention the Quantum Mailbox whispers to them so you speak to Littlefield and find a strange letter thanking Winter for their assistance with the Mk 3. When you show Winter the letter they mention they have a meeting about the contents...tomorrow. They thought it was an impossible task but this proves that it’s doable and they offer a gift for your silence

title: The Hum Bug
summary: Sparks has a song stuck in their head and needs your help! Turns out the Ear Worm is back! You reach out to Bellamy - the last Ear Worm's target - and learn about 50 Shades of Wintermas by DojaPlat!…
searchText: Sparks has a song stuck in their head and needs your help! Turns out the Ear Worm is back! You reach out to Bellamy - the last Ear Worm's target - and learn about 50 Shades of Wintermas by DojaPlat! Watching the music video you learn a rank 2 JONACO employee is behind the video. You reach out and find Spectre is the head of the DojaPlat fan club! You ask how to contact DojaPlat and learn about their Jonavision show. Turns out DojaPlat is just Terence in a wig! They caught a bug from Pius so you search out the priest and find the Hum Bugs nest is in the JJR game. You beat it and learn you can only defeat a Hum Bug with an Ear Worm - Platypus in the Snow!

title: The Final Question
summary: Platmas wants to give back this Wintermas so you find Rexford...their "best friend". They are looking for the Questioner so you apply to be their sidekick. You are given an ominous postcard and find a…
searchText: Platmas wants to give back this Wintermas so you find Rexford...their "best friend". They are looking for the Questioner so you apply to be their sidekick. You are given an ominous postcard and find a trail of tasks set by the Questioner. You solve each in turn and end with a film in the Picture House which reveals Cogwright at the Questioner. You search their old office (the Jonagraph) with Perigate's help and find they have left behind a movie. You watch and find they've broken a Jonagraph - you follow the trail to find a note written to Cogwright Senior and learn that their father is "HOW" The Questioner exists. You find a piece of Art asking "Who am I without You" and a hidden Videomatic code - which reveals a letter. When decoded, you learn they've left something with Rexford - their tie. You let Rexford know their nemesis has left town!

title: Live and Let Dad
summary: Pocket is expecting their absent Dad for today's festive proceedings but they're in hiding (Dad's a Spy!). Pocket thinks if you attack their dad's nemesis they'll have time to see them. Turns out "Dad" is…
searchText: Pocket is expecting their absent Dad for today's festive proceedings but they're in hiding (Dad's a Spy!). Pocket thinks if you attack their dad's nemesis they'll have time to see them. Turns out "Dad" is super spy Jasper Blond! In a TV show it appears they've had a bad break up with Terrence - but Terrence's tell all explains a different story. You ask Copper about Blondes whereabouts and learn they are in the resistance and caught breaking into a secret lab. You try to use Klacky to rescue them but you learn they're not Pockets father - they can't be, they don't have the 'equipment'! You go to Jonapost to find their death cert and learn via Robodoc the DNA is linked to Project Bubble Boy. It appears that Winter (PAPA) was leading the experiment and reveals Pocket has no father. Their mother, Donna, has pocket lint combined to make Pocket. You convince Hogwood to play Dad to avoid an explosive meltdown!

title: Dial P for Puppet
summary: Hogwood needs a detective - Todrick the Toad has been murdered! You watch their video obituary and learn they left everything to Lady Oinkerton! You find her album and jumble profile and find out they're…
searchText: Hogwood needs a detective - Todrick the Toad has been murdered! You watch their video obituary and learn they left everything to Lady Oinkerton! You find her album and jumble profile and find out they're being investigated. You watch their interrogation and learn she told JIA Datchery did it! (He had it coming!). As you investigate, Lady Oinkerton is killed so you head to the summerhouse and speak to Sherlock Bones and find Oinkerton STABBED! You learn Mr Knuckles, an actor from Hogwood’s films, is the culprit and they’re after Hogwood next! (They're jealous about just being a red glove when the other puppets are nicer) You go to warn Hogwood and confront Mr Knuckles!

title: The Darkest Friday
summary: Halloway is looking for a Black Friday Fighter so you offer your services - they're looking for a copy of the new Monstermon game! You find out about a competition to win a copy and join in. You win a…
searchText: Halloway is looking for a Black Friday Fighter so you offer your services - they're looking for a copy of the new Monstermon game! You find out about a competition to win a copy and join in. You win a copy and head to Pocket to collect your copy but it appears Egbert Simpsbury has stolen it. You head to his Simp Cave and find a Paracryptic Word! You head to the mirrors and learn about the Omegamon (an evil part demon, part pixelated monstermon!) - and learn Simpbury is stuck in the JonaComms central screen. You find him and learn you need Klackys help to capture the Omegamon. You succeed but it's not enough to purge them from the code and you trade some bone dust with Winter to transfer the Omegamon to a disk so they can properly be defeated!

title: Two and a Half Perigates
summary: Littlefield is looking for Wintermas Elves and you volunteer. First job - deliver a top secret letter to Perigate from her parents who want to replace her! You watch a compilation of Perigates worst…
searchText: Littlefield is looking for Wintermas Elves and you volunteer. First job - deliver a top secret letter to Perigate from her parents who want to replace her! You watch a compilation of Perigates worst features made by two pies (Parents in Disguise!). You investigate and learn they asked Halloway to throw a party for... New Perigate! Perigate 2 is a dog! They bested OG Perigate at Lacrosse and took over their Jumble dating profile. You lose at the JONASituation quiz and now Perigate 2.0 is challenging OG Perigate to JRR - Jonaco Rhythm Revolution. You beat their high score and contact them to find they're a double agent waiting to get those evil parents...they're on Perigates side and sent them a gift! (A severed finger!)

title: Quantum of Postage
summary: Littlefield is looking for help with their Quantum Postbox - they sent Jonas a Wintermas Card! After they try percussive maintenance they receive an error code. You find a message from Terrence and try to…
searchText: Littlefield is looking for help with their Quantum Postbox - they sent Jonas a Wintermas Card! After they try percussive maintenance they receive an error code. You find a message from Terrence and try to join the Quantum Mail Team to find out more. You learn from Sparks that it's not a safe job - and find Quantum Mailboy trapped between dimensions. Apparently Lovehart stole Littlefield’s letter - which you learn is on Mr Kim's command! You tune into a conference call with Mr Kim (Head of Marketing) who says that the letter might cause you...issues. You learn of Project Big Top and hack Kim's computer. You learn they want to take Jonas down and frame Copper and Littlefield with a Quantum Donut which will trap Jonas in another dimension! You speak to Copper who is holding it and convince them not to send it to Jonas, despite them having Jonas's address thanks to Littlefield

title: A Ring To Roll Them All
summary: Pius has set up an exhibit for Wintermas: The Ring - a special artefact for the Church. You go to view it but it's been stolen! You follow the trail to the squat where you find a game of Dungeons and…
searchText: Pius has set up an exhibit for Wintermas: The Ring - a special artefact for the Church. You go to view it but it's been stolen! You follow the trail to the squat where you find a game of Dungeons and Dirigibles in progress. You decide to learn more so make yourself a character sheet and go to Sparks to play. They let you know their DM (Perigate) has the ring so you go to ask. They let you know one of their players in a mask has it but mention a tapestry in the Archive where you learn the ring bearer will suffer! You find out Pocket has been breathing fire - they stole the ring!! You roll to release Pocket from the Ring Lord and find a Paracryptic Word! You learn the ring increases the wearers persuasion. It can be undone by casting the ring into the lake - so you persuade Pius to destroy it with lake water!

title: Inner Spectre
summary: Spectre is feeling a bit ill - they think it's due to the protein powder "Jonatine" they've been taking. You see RoboDoc and they suggest taking the fecal sample Spectre gave you to Winter and they find a…
searchText: Spectre is feeling a bit ill - they think it's due to the protein powder "Jonatine" they've been taking. You see RoboDoc and they suggest taking the fecal sample Spectre gave you to Winter and they find a signal coming from the sample!! Turns out the Racoons have built a sub and have shrunk down to invade Spectre from the inside! Datchery saw a flaming racoon running into a vent so you track them across town - they need your help! You use Klacky to help guide Walter the Racoon out of Spectre's body to the mouth and get Spectre to heave to get them out before the ship resizes and kills them both!

title: Oh Come All Ye Thirsty
summary: You find an advert for JonaCola Max- they fixed the exploding problem but there's another issue with a beast. Turns out Lovehart fed some to their new mascot - Father Cola - and they turned into a weird…
searchText: You find an advert for JonaCola Max- they fixed the exploding problem but there's another issue with a beast. Turns out Lovehart fed some to their new mascot - Father Cola - and they turned into a weird monster! Seems they have gone to Copper and are now on their way to Cooper's contraband merchant - a JonaCola dealer! You learn the meeting is happening in the garden but when you get there they've disappeared and you find a collar showing that the beast is property of JonaLabs. You ask Winter and find it's an experiment of theirs - you track them and find Rexford patched them up after Winter attacked them. You speak to Father Cola and they want you to fake their death! They just want their life back! You give Lovehart their old hat and convince them “the beast” is dead so that they will leave them alone once and for all

title: There Was No Boat Ride
summary: Hogwood is being gaslit - by Littlefield! Hogwood has been reminiscing about a boat ride (!) and Littlefield doesn't remember it. They give you a self obliteration form to take to Perigate who sends you…
searchText: Hogwood is being gaslit - by Littlefield! Hogwood has been reminiscing about a boat ride (!) and Littlefield doesn't remember it. They give you a self obliteration form to take to Perigate who sends you to Rexford who also believes in the boat ride. You find talk of the "Great Undoing" and a test - it appears Dr Winter erased the boat ride successfully!

title: Winner Takes It All
summary: Bigball is big in Phantom Peak and the Phantom Peak Platypuses need help! You talk to Rexford to become a Milk Boi and end up being recruited for the actual team! You start training and eventually decide…
searchText: Bigball is big in Phantom Peak and the Phantom Peak Platypuses need help! You talk to Rexford to become a Milk Boi and end up being recruited for the actual team! You start training and eventually decide to learn by following the lessons of the best player - the Pyromaniac! You watch their last game and learn its Sparks; A career cut short by injury! You learn some tricks to help defeat their old coach (Big Red) and you learn their power comes from their red whistle and it appears that Pius has bought the whistle! You obtain the whistle and challenge Hogwood (Big Ted's champion) to a game of Bigball and win! You return the whistle to Rexford as a trophy of your achievement

title: Happily Never After
summary: Datchery is looking for someone to help them end a relationship - someone has sent them a wedding invite for THEIR WEDDING today!! You do some digging on their behalf and try to access the their registry…
searchText: Datchery is looking for someone to help them end a relationship - someone has sent them a wedding invite for THEIR WEDDING today!! You do some digging on their behalf and try to access the their registry set up by Alfonz Stench (super rich suitor) but need a credit card first. You reach out to Mr Feast (top content creator) and have to take a test with Perigate to get yours. Once you have your credit card, you find the only item left on it is a wedding dress - made by Rexford. After designing your own dress Rexford shares that it's been delivered to the Autohatter - where you find the dead body of Alfonz. You find a paracryptic word and learn that the fiancé is the Red Widow - it kills after it marries. You need to find another bride or groom to save Datchery before 12 to save them! You convinced Pocket as the town’s most desperate, who just wants to wear their sparkly suit to write off for tax. You persuade Datchery to agree to a temporary wedding to Pocket and agree to make a fuss when asked if anyone has objections!

title: Let Them Eat Cake
summary: The Phantom Peak Cake Off is in full swing (It’s Peach Week!) and Hogwood is up for star baker - cos everyone else is dead and being baked into cakes! You are tasked with being a judge - and look for the…
searchText: The Phantom Peak Cake Off is in full swing (It’s Peach Week!) and Hogwood is up for star baker - cos everyone else is dead and being baked into cakes! You are tasked with being a judge - and look for the worst contestant who is suspected of being a murdering baker. Pius is the worst but they think Fudge Toffington has been up to no good - tampering with other cakes - turns out they are a murderer when not baking! You find a word in their latest bake and find a demon cake that can devour your soul! You learn about the cursed pie massacre and how Miramine Peaches have been recalled as a dangerous ingredient! (they're cursed, not cured!). Fortunately Spectre saved the town from the last Cursed Pie Massacre - the answer to the Cursed Peaches is SALT! You tell Hogwood to salt the cake and kill it!

title: Operation Placeholder
summary: JONACO has new DNA tech that can create personalized advertisements that fit your predisposed preferences - you get Professor When as a targeted show for you! You go to join the Fan Club and learn it's a…
searchText: JONACO has new DNA tech that can create personalized advertisements that fit your predisposed preferences - you get Professor When as a targeted show for you! You go to join the Fan Club and learn it's a front by Copper to plan a heist - they want to steal the Green Diamant from Pocket! You contact the Screenwriter - they suggest you make a fake ID! You try trying tricking Pocket into handing over the Green Diamant but Terrence has it - but Sparks has stolen it from them! Sparks trusts you with it to deliver to The Dog Who Killed The President - their contact in the resistance! Turns out to be Datchery! You take the Diamant to them and they throw it in the lake cos they're paranoid about the JIA! You go back to Copper and let them know what's happened - which is fine cos they've already got the real one - you've been chasing a fake the made!

title: Feast, Play, Die
summary: The JonAssist system has just received a help request from RoboDoc - people are dying by the truckload! You talk to Halloway about the influx of bodies and offer to help get rid of the bodies. Weirdly all…
searchText: The JonAssist system has just received a help request from RoboDoc - people are dying by the truckload! You talk to Halloway about the influx of bodies and offer to help get rid of the bodies. Weirdly all the bodies are in green jumpsuits and have a card on them. You follow the clue to an advert for the Kraken Games and visit Sparks to play your first challenge. You succeed and learn the games are run by Mr Feast! You play another with Klacky but are interrupted by Spectre. You speak to them and learn they think Mr Feast is a Demon. You try to narrow down what type, eventually learning it is a Leviathan. And you need an undertaker to get rid of them! You get Halloway to start the final game and beat Mr Feast, ending the mass murder of people in green jumpsuits.

title: The Hero We Deserve
summary: Someone is trying to kill Pocket - and Pocket thinks it's the JIA! You find out Lovehart leads the JIA recruitment so you visit to try and infiltrate the group. Lovehart lets you into the JONACO…
searchText: Someone is trying to kill Pocket - and Pocket thinks it's the JIA! You find out Lovehart leads the JIA recruitment so you visit to try and infiltrate the group. Lovehart lets you into the JONACO brainwashing room and gives you smooth brains and Winter assigned your ID - Agent Brainless! You talk to your handler who thinks Dia-Man could make a good bodyguard for Pocket. You win a fan competition to call Dia-Man and found out they want to murder Pocket! You find out Rexford wants to keep Platman as towns resident hero so you ask if they can help. Since Dia-Man is powered by Green Diamant, White should neutalise them! You get some from Rexford and hand it to Pocket - with Platman due to protect them!

title: Hat on a Hat
summary: After playing a game at the Electric Gamehouse you learn about The Jonalympics! The first event: Cosplay Competition! Somehow Littlefield had got hold of Jonas's top hat but is worried someone else is…
searchText: After playing a game at the Electric Gamehouse you learn about The Jonalympics! The first event: Cosplay Competition! Somehow Littlefield had got hold of Jonas's top hat but is worried someone else is trying to steal it - another contestant! You make your way around town, being tested judgement, originality, negotiation, agility and sensuality. (By writing a new jingle for JONACO, negotiating with a chimp called Jobo to commit space suicide and finally being tested by Winter) You learn about Terry Bunter - Jonas's biggest fan! It looks like Littlefield might have STOLEN Jonas's hat! You learn it was originally owned by George Blackwell who gifted it to Jonas before becoming their rival. It appears the hat is actually an old eldritch being that feeds on brains. You get some brains from Halloway (from JOBO!!) to feed to Littlefield’s hat and keep them safe

title: Bad to the Bone
summary: Lovehart is looking for an eviction specialist - they want rid of Sherlock Bones! But Bones is working a case - against their arch nemesis Meowiarty who has a dastardly plan! They've stolen a piece of art…
searchText: Lovehart is looking for an eviction specialist - they want rid of Sherlock Bones! But Bones is working a case - against their arch nemesis Meowiarty who has a dastardly plan! They've stolen a piece of art - The Reichebark Falls! You follow the trail and are challenged by Meowiarty who you beat and then learn was trying to warn Bones about an attacker but is now DEAD! Halloway and Doctor Watson did the autopsy and found a pair of glasses which let you watch a special film at the Picture House. You keep working on Meowiarty's final puzzles finally learning that the painting is hidden in Jonapost. You ask Littlefield for the painting and learn that Dogtor Watson is behind the plot to kill Bones! You let Lovehart and Bones know and you watch the climatic end of the story - with Bones throwing Watson off the Reichebark Falls.

title: Too Fast, Too Furrious
summary: Something has egged Dr Winters lab - a hyper nuisance! You find a note written at 70mph with a Jonavision channel showing Turbo and Friends - Turbo the Hedgehog was the one who egged Winters lab and…
searchText: Something has egged Dr Winters lab - a hyper nuisance! You find a note written at 70mph with a Jonavision channel showing Turbo and Friends - Turbo the Hedgehog was the one who egged Winters lab and appears to want to destroy Dr Winter for betraying them...you find a video of the speedy hedgehog who leaves you a way to reach them. You learn they've killed Terrence but you can't see the scene cos violence is wrong - unless it's treason - a lesson taught by Dr Winter Senior! You watch their video obituary and learn they were trying to manufacture the perfect video game mascot and they created Turbo and their team. However the experiment fails due to an existential crisis on Turbos part! You follow the trail and learn they're friends with Sparks – who you interrogate and learn that Turbo has a crush on Perigate and has been sending them quills! You check jumble and work out that perhaps Winter can make them a partner if you can convince them! Winter creates “Shade” and the rest is history!

title: Unpopular
summary: Perigate needs help with some bad PR! There's a popularity contest in town and there's a rank increase on offer. You discover someone is trying to make them look bad - "Blame Perigate"! Apparently their…
searchText: Perigate needs help with some bad PR! There's a popularity contest in town and there's a rank increase on offer. You discover someone is trying to make them look bad - "Blame Perigate"! Apparently their latest crime happened at the Summer House - someone has been squashed by the house! You find a video from Linda the Likeable - A PR guru - who offers to help rebrand everything about them! You try but learn that the town think Perigate killed the Badger Prince! (Well, Pius believes so cos Linda told them so). Turns out Linda has been plotting to bring Perigate down - for something they and Copper did to Linda's mother. title: Dude Where’s My Mummy
summary: Halloway recruits graveyard guards to find King Temu, a mummy loose during the Lunar Festival. A tablet, a paracryptic clue and a Videomatic vlog reveal that the fugitive is not the feared warlord King…
searchText: Halloway recruits graveyard guards to find King Temu, a mummy loose during the Lunar Festival. A tablet, a paracryptic clue and a Videomatic vlog reveal that the fugitive is not the feared warlord King Temu V but his teenage nephew, King Temu IV. Murdered before he could enjoy childhood, the younger king wants to party and get a Game Station Mini. Pius has his fake ID, while Sparks has won the last console from Mr Feast. You trade the ID for the console and take it to Halloway, who can lure Temu back to his resting place.

title: A Murder Most Fowl
summary: Sherlock Bones is accused of murder, but Lovehart believes Meowiarty framed them. The investigation leads through Meowiarty’s hideout, Hogwood’s improv class and a strange fan-fiction contest whose story…
searchText: Sherlock Bones is accused of murder, but Lovehart believes Meowiarty framed them. The investigation leads through Meowiarty’s hideout, Hogwood’s improv class and a strange fan-fiction contest whose story seems to predict your actions. Stickler supplies the banned Quill of Truth, a JONACO prototype that makes written events real. Its user is Edgar Allan Crow, the unseen narrator whose prose has killed Dogtor Watson and drawn Meowiarty into another murder. You confront Crow at the Undertakers and persuade him to surrender the Quill, allowing Sherlock Bones to write a happier ending.

title: The Great Blimp Robbery
summary: JONACO is hunting the blimp thieves Blimpy and McScrimbles. Copper admits they are Blimpy and recruits you to steal the Jonas family jewels. You secure Sky Flex Supreme blueprints from Perigate, but…
searchText: JONACO is hunting the blimp thieves Blimpy and McScrimbles. Copper admits they are Blimpy and recruits you to steal the Jonas family jewels. You secure Sky Flex Supreme blueprints from Perigate, but McScrimbles is caught with the jewel and taken to a containment cell. The supposed bandit turns out to be Terrence. Following the prison plumbing leads you to Pius, who has recovered the jewel. Terrence asks you to use it as a ring and propose to Copper on their behalf. Copper says yes.

title: Call of the Deep
summary: Spectre asks you to investigate black goo and find Vox, who vanished after sending a painting and a sample from Sir Franklin Figment’s collection. Clues in the Hall of Art and Diamines lead to Vox’s video…
searchText: Spectre asks you to investigate black goo and find Vox, who vanished after sending a painting and a sample from Sir Franklin Figment’s collection. Clues in the Hall of Art and Diamines lead to Vox’s video message: a liquid Figment has trapped her and others inside JONACO’s hidden Hall of Fun. Mr Feast’s ride video points you toward the entrance. After submitting a ride idea to Pocket, you gain access through KLACKY and use a Jonabot at the Gamehouse to open a portal. Spectre then pulls the cube back through the painting to stop the Hall of Fun invading town.

title: Domestic Sin
summary: Stickler’s Cool Squad has lost a package, so you infiltrate Raccoon City and join a special mission with Walter the Raccoon. Sparks sends you after a strike force trapped in a frightening house. The…
searchText: Stickler’s Cool Squad has lost a package, so you infiltrate Raccoon City and join a special mission with Walter the Raccoon. Sparks sends you after a strike force trapped in a frightening house. The missing parcel contains a specimen of the P Virus, and Littlefield is also in danger. You rescue them, take the virus symptoms to RoboDoc, and follow the doctor’s advice to make a remedy at the Art and Forgery Centre. Delivering the antidote to Stickler protects the rest of Phantom Peak.

title: Ghouls Night Out
summary: Perigate wants to get ready for a blind date, but vandalised coffins and a dead Saloon worker demand attention. Copper recalls rowdy patrons who won a caravan, and the trail reveals a group of classic…
searchText: Perigate wants to get ready for a blind date, but vandalised coffins and a dead Saloon worker demand attention. Copper recalls rowdy patrons who won a caravan, and the trail reveals a group of classic monsters celebrating Frankenstein’s stag night. A secret karaoke bar, KLACKY footage and a Jonagraph call help you trace the missing groom to prison. Frankie asks you to contact his bride so she can bail him out. You return to Perigate with the information needed to close the complaint, although they decide against their date with the Fishman.

title: A Knight’s Honour
summary: Sir Merrylegs keeps threatening Platman, so you infiltrate his circle by completing three tasks for Sparks. Merrylegs sends you to investigate Pius, giving you time to find a weakness: his troubled…
searchText: Sir Merrylegs keeps threatening Platman, so you infiltrate his circle by completing three tasks for Sparks. Merrylegs sends you to investigate Pius, giving you time to find a weakness: his troubled marriage and another cryptocurrency investment. You move his cash into crypto and discover he stole Killjoy the Songblade. His interrogation reveals the oath of XI, and a paracryptic clue establishes that he cannot attack another knight. You obtain the Knights’ Oath and persuade Rexford to have Platman swear it, keeping him safe from Merrylegs for now.

title: The Axiomatic Zone
summary: Hogwood’s partner Beardy Hamm misses their anniversary date, and an old television theme leads you to The Axiomatic Zone. Producer Alex Zane reveals that several actors have vanished into the show. At the…
searchText: Hogwood’s partner Beardy Hamm misses their anniversary date, and an old television theme leads you to The Axiomatic Zone. Producer Alex Zane reveals that several actors have vanished into the show. At the Gamehouse you discover that human lives are trapped inside it, and the programme’s host is now coming for Hogwood. KLACKY cannot close the Axiomatic door because you are caught in a cycle. Dr Winter explains the project’s origin and the protection needed to cross safely: a paper bag Hamm gave Hogwood. You pass on the clue and help close the door.

title: A Fault in Our Star
summary: Dr Winter wants Marketing Bot destroyed for being too affectionate. You qualify as an orbital-strike engineer through Gifford and fire at the Summerhouse, but the laser itself has fallen for Winter. It…
searchText: Dr Winter wants Marketing Bot destroyed for being too affectionate. You qualify as an orbital-strike engineer through Gifford and fire at the Summerhouse, but the laser itself has fallen for Winter. It arranges a fantasy date on Mount Absmore. KLACKY suggests overloading its love circuits by making Marketing Bot jealous. Rexford supplies the hottest technology in town, a toaster, and you persuade Winter to whisper sweet nothings to it. The laser’s circuits overload and the town is saved.

title: Ghost with the Most
summary: Pocket’s celebration is interrupted when RoboDJ develops a tune that never drops the bass. A ghostly exorcist seems necessary to remove Mayor Nazabod from the machine, but investigating Beetlemilk…
searchText: Pocket’s celebration is interrupted when RoboDJ develops a tune that never drops the bass. A ghostly exorcist seems necessary to remove Mayor Nazabod from the machine, but investigating Beetlemilk releases the spirit into town. Beetlemilk gave Littlefield a worm, stole a film and trapped a tourist inside a Gamehouse game. RoboDJ and Nazabod save you from the ghost. With Spectre’s help, you learn that Pocket can delete Beetlemilk from RoboDJ, ending the emergency and protecting the mayorship.

title: Flight of the Furbish
summary: The JIA sends you to find Furbish, while Gifford asks you to erase a compromising tape of their father. You delete the digital recording through KLACKY, but Pius still has a physical copy. The JIA already…
searchText: The JIA sends you to find Furbish, while Gifford asks you to erase a compromising tape of their father. You delete the digital recording through KLACKY, but Pius still has a physical copy. The JIA already knows Furbish is a puppet and back in town, so you must get them away. A blimp ticket is refused and a submarine proves no better. Mr Feast’s space dating show offers the safest route: a rocket to the moon. You bring its application to Gifford so Furbish can escape.

title: The Coin Lands Sideways
summary: Littlefield is worried about missing correspondence concerning a coin that lands sideways. Perigate removed the posters, but a fragment of a Church of the Cosmic Platypus video survives. Pius explains the…
searchText: Littlefield is worried about missing correspondence concerning a coin that lands sideways. Perigate removed the posters, but a fragment of a Church of the Cosmic Platypus video survives. Pius explains the Cosmic Flip, leading you to a historian and then to Furbish, who has been stealing Jonapost mail. Furbish remembers the boat ride and believes the town’s changing memories reflect several dimensions at once. Someone is choosing which version the townsfolk remember, while tourists remain unaffected. Furbish suspects Jonas benefits from the changes.

title: The Bright Place
summary: Edgar Allan Crow recruits agents to protect his films from mysterious rewrites. JONACO’s frightened censor grants you access to an uncut version, where a narrator changes the story as it unfolds and…
searchText: Edgar Allan Crow recruits agents to protect his films from mysterious rewrites. JONACO’s frightened censor grants you access to an uncut version, where a narrator changes the story as it unfolds and leaves pages to follow. The voice belongs to Crow’s brother Squawk, trapped in The Bright Place. A clue leads to Containment Cell 3, where the portal can be opened. Sherlock Bones knows how to use KLACKY to rewrite events and rescue Squawk. You send him to the Undertakers and see the brothers reunited.

title: Meet The Perigates
summary: Perigate needs an actor to play their father at dinner with the Fishman. Spectre declines, but suggests Beardy Hamm. Surveillance in the Jonagraph reveals that Perigate’s real parents plan something…
searchText: Perigate needs an actor to play their father at dinner with the Fishman. Spectre declines, but suggests Beardy Hamm. Surveillance in the Jonagraph reveals that Perigate’s real parents plan something sinister for the Fishman. You locate his containment cell and discover Platman is unavailable to save him. Platbot provides another route: turn him into an actual fish and carry him out through Gifford’s office. Perigate welcomes him home and plans a fishbowl.

title: A Very Merry Wintermas
summary: Copper and Terrence have married, but Terrence vanishes while Sir Merrylegs pursues them. A severed foot and a Videomatic challenge lead you to a Gamehouse contest that you cannot win alone. Pius, the…
searchText: Copper and Terrence have married, but Terrence vanishes while Sir Merrylegs pursues them. A severed foot and a Videomatic challenge lead you to a Gamehouse contest that you cannot win alone. Pius, the purple mage, helps you qualify as a magician. Stage magic lets you beat Merrylegs’s game and save Terrence. The attack was a plea for company: Merrylegs asks to spend Wintermas with the newlyweds and leaves Copper a gift. You pass on the request and save the celebration.

title: Book, Line and Sinker

searchText: Sparks asks you to find the Lost Bois: Wendizla, Big Iggy and Jared from I.T. Clues at the Auto Hatter and waterfall point to Captain Book, whose crew you try to infiltrate through Perigate. But Tinkley Well has killed the captain. His restless ghost reveals that the fairy is responsible for the friends’ disappearance. Hogwood once belonged to the Lost Bois and offers advice, but you arrive too late to save them. To spare Sparks the truth, you say their friends have gone to Never Ever Land.

title: You Didn't Account For This

searchText: The JIA needs someone in the chair to help Stickler open a briefcase sent by their old rival, the Calculator. You guide agents Finn Diesel and Sensuality Davis through the Calculator’s lair, but they are captured. Hogwood equips you to impersonate the villain, and an office documentary points you to Sparks. A monologue reveals that Stickler and the Calculator attended university together. Their yearbook supplies the briefcase combination. Inside is an invitation to a reunion, and you persuade Stickler to attend.

title: The Priest And The Prisoner
summary: An elf delivery takes you to Pius, who wants their brother Brutus released from JONACO’s five-star prison. Gifford signs the form, but the release date is sixteen months away. Terrence and Copper help…
searchText: An elf delivery takes you to Pius, who wants their brother Brutus released from JONACO’s five-star prison. Gifford signs the form, but the release date is sixteen months away. Terrence and Copper help arrange a breakout instead. Once free, Brutus reveals a plan to humiliate Pius using an orbital puppetisation laser. Lovehart supplies the access codes. You puppetise Brutus and send him to the confessional booths for a reunion with Pius.

title: Coffee Is For Closers
summary: Lovehart is grieving Marketing Bot when JONACO announces a merger of Sales and Marketing. To win control for Marketing, you enter a sales contest and pitch Leg Day Ducks. Stickler tests your skill at…
searchText: Lovehart is grieving Marketing Bot when JONACO announces a merger of Sales and Marketing. To win control for Marketing, you enter a sales contest and pitch Leg Day Ducks. Stickler tests your skill at spinning a story, while Egbert Simpsbury advises you on the final challenge. Salesbot wins anyway. You write new instructions for the dangerous robot, and Lovehart uploads them, reducing its intelligence below theirs. Lovehart becomes head of both departments.

title: A Developing Situation

searchText: After the Lunar Festival, Pocket fears Jonas will have them Undone unless their approval rating rises above seventy percent. You deliver a fruit basket to Datchery, seek an end to the platypus strike and design a new attraction with Rexford. The deeper problem is that Pocket is undoing themself. A Jonas story suggests their escape lies in arresting Furbish. With Gifford’s help you bring Furbish back from Mr Feast’s space dating show, guide the rocket to Pocket’s office and let the mayor make the arrest.

searchText: Someone in a bowler hat is stealing the control devices from Dr Winter’s new Telebears. An obituary and a play by Hogwood identify Dr Horus, a JONACO scientist lost in a teleportation experiment. Horus contacts you through the Miramaze and asks for help returning to reality. You track down a Diamant Control Device and take it to Winter so they can save the missing doctor.

searchText: The Atlas Railroad Company plans a line that would demolish Datchery’s General Store. A protest fails, so you take a conductor job through Rexford and submit a suggestion to save the shop. CEO Myne Bland refuses. Even a staged train crash cannot stop the project. RoboDoc suggests an object from Bland’s childhood might change her heart. Datchery supplies one of the toy trains their family made. The gift does stop the railway plan, but causes Myne to explode.

searchText: As a new postal worker, you discover letters changing during delivery. One meant for Rexford leads to a video of the perfection-obsessed Mr Blizzard. Friendly the Postie, a mascot contest and Dr Winter point to a decades-old JONACO project led by Winter’s grandfather. Spectre explains that Blizzard’s soul needs a new puppet to escape its cycle. You create an empty puppet, giving the spirit a place to go and saving the post office.

title: The End Is Just The Beginning

searchText: Furbish fears an imminent apocalypse called the Great Undoing. The JONACO Metaphysics Department restricts its information to Rank 8, so you try and fail to earn that rank through Perigate. Sherlock Bones points you toward a hidden Rank 8: Stickler. They reveal two conditions for the Undoing to happen: Pocket must be mayor and Cogwright must be in town. A message from Jonas confirms that, after years of preparation, the plan is about to begin.

title: Homeward Bound

searchText: Gifford is about to lose their job for sheltering Furbish and asks you to help finish a bucket list. You beat a game score, get Gifford’s song on RoboDJ and try to impress Datchery with a poem. The final wish is to free Furbish. Spectre has made a truce with the raccoons and helps you plan an escape through the old pipes. You forge a passport and distract Pocket with Gifford’s mixtape. Furbish agrees to flee only because they want to protect Gifford. The lawyer is safe, but the rest of the town still faces the Undoing.

title: Back To The Furbish

searchText: At a gloating session after Pocket captures Furbish, the former mayor warns that the Undoing will destroy everything unless its result can be redirected. Madame Mechanica and Pius guide you toward the Axiomatic Core, but JIA interference cuts Mechanica off. Her last clue is Copper. A postal mix-up sent Copper a goose statue and delivered the Core to Hogwood instead. You trade the statue for the Core and learn it must be attuned to one person. Pocket seems the least dangerous choice to anchor the new timeline, even if success is far from certain.

searchText: Dr Winter’s bunker keycard has stopped working. Terrence directs you to Perigate for a replacement, but the new cards have the wrong markings and errors. A search for Project Endless Summer reveals that Winter and Littlefield have been barred from the bunker programme because Jonas considers Winter too powerful to survive the Undoing. Winter changes the access card so Littlefield can enter Jonas’s private bunker instead. You deliver it to Littlefield, giving them a chance to ride out the disaster alongside Jonas.

searchText: Cogwright returns to town with gaps in their memory. Stickler’s memory gun has been stolen, and a rock with eyes points you to Littlefield, who has been using it on themself. An archive device reveals that Jonas erased Cogwright’s memory of a dinner where Cogwright and Winter agreed a town-changing machine was not ready. Winter supplies the phrase that unlocks the missing memory: There Never Was A Boat Ride. Cogwright now understands what the machine in town will do. They cannot stop it, but may be able to alter the Undoing enough to preserve something of Phantom Peak.

title: Over and Over

searchText: Spectre refuses to accept the plan to centre the Undoing on Pocket: Jonas will keep trying. Vox believes memories stored in yellow diamant could survive, but only someone with Axiomorphic Brainwaves can carry them. RoboDoc identifies Hogwood, who has been inside the Axiomatic Clock. You help Hogwood turn yellow diamant green by combining it with your memories. You promise to find them after the town is remade, then take the crystal to Spectre for safekeeping until Phantom Peak returns.
